title: Lisp layer evidence unit
description: One line of <layer root>/<model dir>/units.jsonl, the Lisp image's record of one conclusive compaction unit of a settled adaptable-function definition, which the retire rule reads (docs/lisp-core.md decision 6): a compaction in which the definition ran and failed at least once is a fail, one in which it ran and never failed a pass; one in which it never ran is not recorded. Source: lisp/src/rules/evidence.lisp (append-unit, units-of).

digest.description: The digest of the settled text (layer.Digest).

gen.description: The layer generation that settled the text; units of another settle are not read.

failures.description: How many of its runs in the unit failed its kernel check, errored or timed out.
